summary.en-US: A YouTube-inspired desktop interface for Bilibili.
summary.zh-CN: 为哔哩哔哩提供接近 YouTube 桌面版的界面布局。

version.approval_notes: BiliYouTube replaces the Bilibili home-page presentation with a YouTube-inspired interface. It talks only to Bilibili domains to fetch the signed-in user's profile, followed creators, and recommendation feed. No analytics, telemetry, advertising, or developer-operated server is used. Human-readable TypeScript/Vue source is attached to the submission.
